La marque est également présente à l’international dans plusieurs pays d’Europe. Nous créons des collections et des campagnes qui apportent un petit plus au quotidien des femmes. Avec plus de 1 000 collègues, nous faisons grandir chaque jour une marque pleine d’ambition, de créativité et d’énergie. Notre culture ? Personnelle, engagée et pleine de vie. Ici, vous pouvez vraiment être vous-même et vous avez toute la place pour évoluer, apprendre et avoir un impact concret. Malgré notre forte croissance internationale, les échanges restent directs, avec des circuits de communication courts, une organisation horizontale et une ambiance très conviviale. En équipe, nous avançons ensemble et aimons faire la différence au quotidien. description: Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI agents, human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly. As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Head of Infrastructure to own and scale the infrastructure foundation behind this platform. This is a unique opportunity to lead an infrastructure organization combining carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads , while building the operational maturity required to support 2x growth . You will report directly to Sergei, our CTO, and lead the infrastructure organization — owning operational excellence, team development and execution of infrastructure initiatives, while actively contributing to technical strategy and architecture decisions. Why this role is different Most infrastructure leadership roles today focus on managing cloud platforms and abstracted services. Here, you will own the foundations of a real-time, AI-first communication platform — from hardware and networks to telecom systems, distributed services, and operational processes. Our philosophy is simple: we build and operate our infrastructure ourselves. 100% of our production infrastructure is managed by our teams, giving us full technical ownership, deep system knowledge, and the ability to solve complex challenges without relying on external vendors. This allows us to move faster, make better architectural decisions, and build systems tailored to our needs. You will work across: Telecom infrastructure — we are a global voice carrier powering real-time communications across multiple markets. We manage carrier relationships, routing decisions, and voice traffic flows end-to-end, with the expertise and tooling built internally. On-premise infrastructure — around 95% of our production infrastructure runs on our own hardware across several data centers around the Paris and Frankfurt areas, with servers, networking, and connectivity fully managed by our teams. Cloud infrastructure — while the majority of our production runs on-premise, we strategically leverage cloud services for remote locations and specific workloads where they provide faster deployment and operational efficiency, particularly for smaller-scale deployments. Stateful systems — PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, and others powering high-volume workloads. Distributed systems — the platform is deployed in a fully redundant way across multiple data centers, with the ability to sustain the loss of a data center without impacting workloads. AI infrastructure — GPU workloads and compute infrastructure supporting our AI capabilities. Storage system — Ceph provides our main object and volume storage layer, supporting all other services across the infrastructure. This is infrastructure engineering where reliability, latency, scalability, and operational excellence directly impact the product. You will not simply maintain existing systems. You will help shape the architecture, processes, and team structure required for the next stage of our growth — taking ownership of critical infrastructure decisions from the ground up. Your mission Your goal is to make infrastructure ready for the next stage of scaling up by building a strong operational foundation across all the infrastructure domains. You will: Own infrastructure reliability and operations across the whole stack: incident management, monitoring, alerting, post-mortems and prevention of recurring failures. Improve operational visibility across infrastructure teams: identify bottlenecks, improve processes and drive continuous improvements. Improve capacity planning processes, connecting business growth and infrastructure needs. Lead the evolution of our network and telecom infrastructure : topology, connectivity, carrier relationships, routing, redundancy and voice platform performance and reliability. Own our on-premise infrastructure operations : data centers, hardware, storage, connectivity and deployment practices. Drive scalability and reliability of our stateful infrastructure : PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis and other critical systems. Support the evolution of our AI infrastructure , including GPU workloads and compute clusters. Drive infrastructure improvements with automation, observability and tooling. Partner with engineering teams to ensure applications run reliably on our platforms. Lead and grow the Infrastructure team across Networking, SRE, Stateful Systems, Voice, and Data Center squads. Who we are looking for We are not looking for someone who has mastered every infrastructure domain. We are looking for a strong infrastructure engineer and leader who has built complex systems, understands operational excellence and wants broader ownership. You might be: a Head of Infrastructure looking for a more hands-on technical challenge; an Infrastructure Manager who still enjoys engineering; a Staff/Principal SRE who has been leading infrastructure beyond their formal title; a network or systems engineer who grew into technical leadership. Must Have Deep expertise in at least 2–3 infrastructure domains, such as: networking; SRE/reliability; database administration; telecom/voice infrastructure; hardware/on-premise infrastructure. Proven experience building and improving infrastructure operations: establishing processes, improving reliability practices, driving incident management and creating effective ways of working across multiple infrastructure domains. Experience leading technical teams where different groups own different areas of infrastructure (for example networking, SRE, databases, systems or platform engineering). Strong hands-on mindset: you stay close to technology, understand technical details and lead through context and expertise. Self-taught, hands-on background — you have grown technically by solving complex problems beyond your formal role. Fluent English, both written and spoken. French or other languages are a plus. Ability to work onsite in Paris. Nice to Have Experience with: Telecom or carrier infrastructure. Voice platforms or real-time communication systems. PostgreSQL, Kafka, RabbitMQ or Redis operational experience at scale. Dark fiber, peering and advanced networking. Kubernetes in production. GPU infrastructure. Incident command and post-mortem culture. About You You are motivated by complexity and ownership, not titles. You solve problems before being asked. You are comfortable with ambiguity — infrastructure is complex, and you know how to make pragmatic technical trade-offs. You enjoy building teams and scaling impact through people, not only systems. You stay curious about networking, hardware trends, observability and modern infrastructure practices. Why join us Own infrastructure decisions with real business impact. Your work will directly influence reliability, customer experience and engineering velocity. Work on infrastructure that cannot simply be outsourced. From telecom networks and hardware to distributed systems and AI workloads, you will solve problems where architecture and engineering decisions matter. Build something from an early stage of maturity. You will help establish the operational discipline, processes and team structure needed for the next phase of growth. Work directly with technical leadership. You will report directly to Sergey, our CTO, who is deeply involved in infrastructure and technical decisions while giving infrastructure leaders the ownership to drive changes. Meeting with the infrastructure team Onsite or online session focused on collaboration, problem-solving and engineering culture. The strongest candidates are often engineers who grew into leadership by taking ownership, solving complex problems and going beyond their formal responsibilities. If you have built and operated complex infrastructure, enjoy solving ambiguous technical challenges and want to shape a critical engineering domain — we would love to talk. We are not looking for someone who has mastered every infrastructure domain.

We are looking for a strong infrastructure engineer and leader who has built complex systems, understands operational excellence and wants broader ownership.

  • a Head of Infrastructure looking for a more hands-on technical challenge;
  • an Infrastructure Manager who still enjoys engineering;
  • a Staff/Principal SRE who has been leading infrastructure beyond their formal title;
  • a network or systems engineer who grew into technical leadership.

Must Have

    • networking;
    • SRE/reliability;
    • database administration;
    • telecom/voice infrastructure;
    • hardware/on-premise infrastructure.

  • Self-taught, hands-on background — you have grown technically by solving complex problems beyond your formal role.

Own infrastructure decisions with real business impact.

title: Technical Advisor – Airframe & Engine
description: About JSSI Founded in 1989 and headquartered in Chicago, Jet Support Services, Inc. (JSSI) is the largest independent provider of hourly cost maintenance programs for business aviation. JSSI delivers comprehensive coverage for engines, airframes, and auxiliary power units (APUs) across more than 300 different aircraft makes and models, helping owners and operators stabilize maintenance budgets, maximize aircraft availability, and protect asset value throughout the lifecycle of ownership. JSSI has built a portfolio of complementary business lines designed to simplify the economic and technical complexity of business aviation; these include Maintenance teams , Traxxall maintenance tracking software, Parts & Engines , Conklin aircraft cost and performance data, and Aviation Capital asset-based financing solutions. Together, these offerings support owners, operators, and maintenance providers with integrated tools spanning ownership and maintenance planning, execution, and financial management. With more than 6,500 aircraft supported through programs and software platforms, JSSI leverages its unique independence, unmatched scale, and data-driven insight to deliver customized solutions and support models aligned to the interests of each client — regardless of aircraft platform. JSSI is backed by leading institutional investors GTCR, Genstar Capital, and Blackstone. Learn more at jetsupport.com . Position Summary The Technical Advisor serves as the primary point of contact between the Client and the maintenance organization for both airframe and engine matters, acting as a trusted technical representative throughout the lifecycle of aircraft maintenance events. This role manages and coordinates client needs across routine maintenance, minor unscheduled findings, major scheduled inspections, and Aircraft on Ground (AOG) situations — for airframes, engines, and related systems — utilizing Product Line Specialists (PLS) as needed to support events requiring specialized assistance. As the customer's key technical liaison, the Technical Advisor acts as an advocate for the Client and provides expert guidance to support informed decision-making, balancing airworthiness, operational impact, cost control, and schedule adherence. Duties and Responsibilities: Collaborate with customers to evaluate and recommend the most appropriate inspection and maintenance alternatives for airframe and engine events. Set up and support customers in coordinating all aspects of maintenance events — including preliminary scheduled inspections, minor unscheduled findings, and major unscheduled or major scheduled events — with assigned repair facilities and service providers. Provide on-site customer representation, particularly during major scheduled inspections. Support customers during Aircraft on Ground (AOG) events, ensuring timely communication and resolution. Create and manage Service Calls to track technical data, event progress, and support financial forecasting. Develop and maintain strong client relationships through regular and proactive communication. Build and sustain working relationships with regional service facilities, mobile repair teams, and other service providers. Research aircraft logbooks and/or perform visual inspections for new enrollments or existing contract reviews. Review and process invoices in AMS, meeting turn-time goals established by Technical Services Management and company policy. Perform event triage by assessing maintenance findings and ensuring each situation is handled appropriately and efficiently, serving as primary liaison between maintenance facilities, parts sourcing vendors, and the customer — handling the event directly or turning it over to a Product Line Specialist as needed. Conduct asset inspections when enrolling new aircraft into service programs. Maintain a thorough working knowledge of applicable contracts, policies, and procedures. Perform additional duties as assigned by Technical Services Management. Desired Credentials: Unrestricted work and residency authorization in the United States required. Airframe and Powerplant (A&P) ratings, or equivalent, required. Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in an Aviation field preferred. 10 years' experience with corporate turbine-powered business aircraft (not commercial) preferred, with particular expertise working with Gulfstream and Bombardier airframes and their associated engine platforms. Excellent Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint skills. Strong interpersonal skills. Ability to read and write articulately and analytically. Clear understanding of relevant technical skills. Ability to multi-task and work well under pressure. Well organized. Have or be able to obtain a passport and perform international travel. At JSSI, we are committed to rewarding our team members with competitive and comprehensive compensation packages that reflect their contributions and talent. For this role, the annual base pay generally ranges from $90,000 to $105,000, with the final offer determined by variable factors including but not limited to market location, job-specific knowledge, skills, education, and experience. In addition, your total rewards package may include an annual discretionary bonus plan, incentive or sales bonus plan, or other form of additional compensation, based on your role. Additionally, for full-time employees based in the USA, Canada, or the Philippines, we are proud to offer a robust suite of benefits. This ranges from insurance offerings such as medical, dental, vision, retirement savings programs, among others, starting day one of employment. For a full overview of our offerings, visit the JSSI Benefits Page on our company website. JSSI is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristic protected by law. JSSI does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or Recruiting Team. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
Ajax Systems est une entreprise technologique internationale et le plus grand fabricant de systèmes de sécurité en Europe, comptant plus de 4,5 millions d’utilisateurs finaux et 330 000 utilisateurs professionnels dans plus de 180 pays à travers le monde. L’entreprise propose des solutions complètes de bout en bout pour la protection des habitations et des entreprises, quelle que soit leur taille. À ce jour, le portefeuille de produits Ajax comprend 280 dispositifs couvrant la protection anti-intrusion, la vidéosurveillance, la sécurité incendie et la protection des personnes, ainsi que le confort et l’automatisation. Ajax Systems emploie aujourd’hui plus de 5 000 collaborateurs.
 
Nous développons des équipes locales, convaincus que les experts sur le terrain sont les mieux placés pour comprendre les spécificités de chaque marché. L’entreprise dispose de représentants commerciaux dans le monde entier, notamment en Italie, Espagne, Allemagne, France, Royaume-Uni, États-Unis, Australie, Afrique du Sud, ainsi que dans de nombreuses autres régions. L’équipe Global Business Development est composée de profils partageant les ambitions élevées et la vision de croissance d’Ajax Systems.
 
La combinaison du meilleur logiciel et d’un matériel puissant a durablement transformé la perception des systèmes de sécurité, tant pour les utilisateurs que pour les professionnels du secteur. Récompensée lors des plus grands salons spécialisés tels que IFSEC, Expoprotection et Intersec, et lauréate de prix prestigieux décernés par des médias de référence comme PSI Magazine et GIT SECURITY, Ajax Systems est aujourd’hui l’un des fabricants de systèmes de sécurité les plus primés en Europe.
La production d’Ajax Systems repose sur quatre sites industriels : deux en Ukraine, un en Turquie et un au Vietnam. Par ailleurs, la certification de l’entreprise selon la norme ISO 14001 garantit un impact environnemental minimal de ses activités de production. La sélection des composants utilisés dans la fabrication des dispositifs Ajax repose sur des déclarations des fournisseurs confirmant leur conformité aux exigences RoHS.
 
L’entreprise est née dans un contexte de révolution et de guerre. C’est pourquoi la résilience est au cœur de l’ADN de la marque. Lutter contre le mal en créant les meilleures solutions de sécurité et d’automatisation constitue la mission constante et inébranlable d’Ajax Systems.

title: Senior Partner Growth Manager
description:
About Us

We are Ocado Commercial, and we are revolutionising online grocery. We partner with the world's leading retailers, providing our innovative Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) – a powerful blend of automation and software – to elevate their e-commerce capabilities. Join us and be part of a team that's shaping the future of retail, working with global giants from Kroger to AEON. 

About the Role

The Senior Partner Growth Manager role is an exciting opportunity in our Partner Success Team to directly influence the commercial success of our partners, some of the largest retailers in EMEA. This position will require reasonable travel to Saudi Arabia and/or Europe. 

Businesses that partner with Ocado come in all shapes and sizes, and leverage our technology in different ways.  In this role, you will combine your knowledge of ecommerce, grocery retail, and online marketing with communication skills and analytical abilities to shape and influence how our partners grow online. 

The Partner Growth Manager will work with the Ocado Partner Account team to drive the growth agenda in our partner’s business, enabling our partners to improve commercial outcomes, grow their customer base, order volume, and overall profitability. 

You will build effective relationships with key commercial, marketing, and ecommerce stakeholders in our partners’ businesses. You will leverage knowledge of customer objectives, strategic know-how, knowledge of the Ocado Smart Platform (OSP), as well as the expertise of our central growth subject matter experts to create and implement successful growth strategies. You will become a first line of e-commerce growth support, leveraging our team of central subject matter experts for more in-depth support. You will support your internal stakeholders in the region with insights and reporting on growth topics, as well as be a source of information and support for your partners. 

As part of the Partner Success Team you will be responsible for supporting our partners in their day to day use of OSP, ensuring that their webshop is configured optimally, using the most impactful OSP features, to drive maximum customer acquisition, retention and basket size.

You will consult with partners through both in-depth projects in close collaboration with our Central Growth and/or Technology teams, as well as ongoing optimisation forums aimed at improving their commercial performance. You will leverage data to drive recommendations that improve overall performance. 

  • The Partner Growth Manager is accountable for shaping and delivering growth strategy for their assigned Partner(s), supporting improved commercial outcomes including customer acquisition, retention, order growth and profitability.
  • Works closely with the Partner’s ecommerce, marketing and technology teams and cross-functional Ocado stakeholders to align growth priorities and execution.
  • Uses growth, trading and customer data and analytics to understand commercial performance, identify trends and opportunities, and deliver clear, actionable recommendations to Partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Accountable for translating Partner growth objectives into clear, prioritised growth initiatives and optimisation opportunities that support long-term commercial success, maximising the potential of the OSP platform.
  • Acts as Ocado’s primary growth and ecommerce subject matter expert for the Partner, using deep knowledge of OSP capabilities and growth / go-to-market expertise to shape recommendations on ecommerce configuration, trading, monetisation and customer experience, as well as sustainable marketing and communications adapted to the local competitive landscape
  • Owns the Partner relationship for e-commerce and growth OSP roadmap engagement, acting as the named point of contact for, trading, monetisation, customer experience roadmap topic, and, in general, any non-operational topic.
  • Represents Partner growth and ecommerce requirements and priorities into Ocado’s roadmap governance processes, supporting feature discovery with clear problem definition, context and Partner business case and value articulation.
  • Monitors delivery and adoption of growth-critical features and capabilities, working with internal teams and Partners to maximise realised commercial value and improve utilisation of growth-enabling functionality.
  • Identifies and escalates risks, dependencies or delivery issues that may impact the Partner’s ability to realise growth from OSP capabilities.

About you

  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential. Arabic and European languages are highly desirable.
  • Bias to action, capable of designing data-driven strategies but also secure implementation
  • Stakeholder, relationship building and networking skills
  • A team player who’s comfortable interacting with Partner teams
  • Self-motivated with an ability to deliver to deadlines and multi-task under pressure
  • Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and uncertainty
  • Able to handle difficult situations, facing challenges with positivity, confidence and pragmatism
  • Experience in one or several of the following fields:
    • Performance marketing within a direct to consumer business (grocery ecommerce experience a plus)
    • Commercial or trading experience in a direct to consumer business ( grocery ecommerce experience a plus)
    • Retail management consulting 
  • Familiarity and passion for data-driven marketing, consumer insight, and ecommerce
  • Familiarity with or experience with measuring and optimizing key growth metrics including user growth, conversion, LTV

What we offer

We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:

  • Time to recharge:
    25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more – and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.
  • Health & wellbeing:
    Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.
  • Family-first policies:
    22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave
  • Financial support:
    Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE), and interest-free loans for train tickets.
  • Commuter perks:
    Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.
  • Exclusive discounts:
    15% off at Ocado.com with free delivery (starting in your first month).

Ocado Group is an equal opportunities employer and as such makes every effort to ensure that all potential employees are treated fairly and equally, regardless of their sex, sexual orientation, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, age, or disability or union membership status.

title: Senior Research Consultant DACH (B2B Focus) (m/f/d)
description:
Allow us to introduce ourselves

Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.

We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over 260 employees spread across 13 countries (we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from +190 markets, globally.

Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? 🚀

Here at Appinio, we value transparency in our recruitment process, and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together: here

Your mission as a Senior Research Consultant

We are looking for a Senior Research Consultant (m/f/d) with a strong quantitative market research background to join our newly dedicated B2B research team in the DACH region. This specialized unit focuses on research projects that specifically survey B2B target groups, professional decision-makers, and niche business audiences (rather than only only standard B2C consumer panels), serving fast-moving consultancy clients and corporate B2B requests.

In this role, you will lead complex quantitative B2B research projects end-to-end, from initial feasibility alignment and study design to reporting and insight presentation. You will act as a senior sparring partner for corporate strategy leads and consultancy teams, translating intricate B2B & B2C data into clear, decision-ready recommendations. You will thrive in a high-velocity environment where speed, rigorous B2B screening logic, strong client presence, and operational precision are essential.

What you’ll be doing

  • End-to-End B2B Project Lead: Manage quantitative research projects end-to-end, including B2B screening design, questionnaire drafting, platform setup, fieldwork monitoring, and data delivery.
  • Methodology & Study Design: Optimise bespoke study designs across core use cases (e.g., Target Group Analysis, U&A, Pricing studies, Concept Testing) mainly tailored to hard-to-reach professional audiences.
  • Senior Client Sparring & Advisory: Act as a trusted partner for fast-paced consultancy and corporate clients, advising on sample feasibility, survey logic, and optimal research approaches under tight deadlines.
  • Commercial & Scoping Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales and Account Management on project scoping, feasibility checks, and methodology definition for complex project requests.
  • Process & Quality Enhancement: Contribute to standardizing B2B screening protocols, sampling frameworks, and best practices to coach other researcher and safeguard delivery speed and research quality across the team.

You will thrive in this role if

  • You have 5+ years of experience in quantitative market research with a distinct focus on surveying B2B target groups and professional decision-makers (agency or consulting background required; pure academic or non-client backgrounds will not fit this role).
  • You have hands-on experience designing studies, writing questionnaires, and executing quantitative projects across core B2B use cases (e.g., U&A, Pricing studies, Concept Testing, Target Group Analysis).
  • You bring proven experience creating executive-ready reports and presenting complex data through clear, compelling storytelling to senior client-side stakeholders.
  • You possess a strategic, commercially minded approach with the self-confidence to guide clients and defend research decisions under pressure.
  • You excel in high-velocity environments, with a demonstrated ability to juggle multiple concurrent projects, prioritize effectively, and stay calm under tight deadlines.
  • You are proficient in German (C2 level required) and English, with outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • You bring a pragmatic, proactive, and resilient mindset with a passion for data quality and innovation.

What’s in it for you?

  • Flexibility Policy - Our flexibility policy means there is no hard cap on the number of vacation days you can take
  • Temporary work from abroad - If you're based in the EU, you can work outside your country of residence for up to 180 days per year
  • All the hardware you need and your own MacBook
  • If you are located in Hamburg or Berlin, you'll get a Deutschland ticket or access to a mobility budget with the NAVIT app to get you to and from the office space
  • Subsidised Urban Sports Club or ClassPass membership based on location
  • In case you’re located in one of the cities where most of our fellow Appinioneers are (Hamburg, Berlin, Munich, London, Madrid, Barcelona, or New York), you can get access to our Co-working spaces

Kind reminder: Please ensure that your application is submitted in English.

This post not only outlines our ideal candidate but also serves as an inspiration for what this role can evolve into. Even if you consider yourself an 80% fit but have a genuine passion for this position, we encourage you to apply. We're eager to hear from individuals who share our enthusiasm.

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.

WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Transition Operations Director

WPP Media is seeking a strategic and experienced Director, Transition Lead to join our team in London. This is a business-critical leadership role, responsible for orchestrating the seamless and successful onboarding of new clients and setting the stage for long-term growth and partnership.

As the Transition Lead, you will own the end-to-end integration of complex, multi-market clients into our network. You will develop and execute robust transition programs, ensuring that all workstreams—from commercial setup to team onboarding and technology integration—are managed flawlessly. This is a unique opportunity to shape our agency's most important new client relationships from day one, ensuring we deliver operational excellence and drive immediate value. This role requires a leader who can navigate a matrixed environment, manage senior stakeholders, and drive change effectively. As part of the role, you'll at times also work across the wider WPP network, including partners in WPP Production and WPP Creative, to deliver integrated solutions. You will be responsible for leading teams in varying compositions based on the task at hand.

  • Transition Strategy & Programme Leadership: Develop and own the end-to-end transition strategy and detailed programme plans for new clients, defining scope, timelines, milestones, and key deliverables.
  • Execution & Coordination: Lead the flawless execution of the transition plan, coordinating across multiple markets and internal functions including client leadership, finance, legal, HR, and technology.
  • Senior Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary, senior point of contact for client executives and internal leadership throughout the transition, ensuring clear, consistent communication and expertly managing expectations.
  • Change Management: Design and implement effective change management strategies to ensure the smooth adoption of new processes, tools, and team structures for both the client and our internal teams.
  • Risk & Issue Management: Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with client transitions, developing contingency plans to ensure a smooth and professional onboarding experience.
  • Team Leadership: Build, manage, and mentor a high-performing transition team, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and accountability. Leadership in a matrix environment.

Skills and Experience

  • An extensive and proven track record in a senior transition, programme management, or project management role, gained within a large-scale media agency, consultancy, or other complex, global organization.
  • Demonstrable success in leading complex, multi-market transitions for large, global clients or leading complex multi-market projects.
  • Deep expertise in applying project, programme, and change management methodologies (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) to deliver successful business outcomes.
  • Exceptional senior stakeholder management and communication skills, with a proven ability to influence and build consensus with executive-level leaders.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience managing complex project budgets and ensuring profitability.
  • Inspirational leadership skills with experience building and developing high-performing teams.
  • A strategic and commercially-minded approach, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and solve complex problems with clarity and confidence.
  • Familiarity with leveraging AI tools and AI-powered support for project management and project management tracking.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Significant prior experience within an agency group active in multi-market environments.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. 

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. 

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

Role Summary and Impact 

At Code, we design and build digital products and platforms for a range of clients.

We’re looking for a Front-end Engineer with strong browser-side engineering skills who cares about how interfaces work in practice.

You’ll work mainly in TypeScript and React, building responsive, accessible and performant interfaces as part of a multidisciplinary product team. We use application frameworks including React Router and Next.js, but strong foundations in HTML, CSS and JavaScript matter just as much.

This is a senior engineering role, so you’ll do more than implement designs. You’ll help shape how interfaces are built, work closely with designers on interaction and behaviour, contribute to technical decisions, and help other engineers improve their front-end skills.

You’ll also contribute to how we approach front-end engineering across Code, sharing what works and challenging approaches when there’s a better way to do things.

Skills and Experience 

  • Build high-quality user interfaces using TypeScript, React, HTML and CSS.
  • Work with React Router, Next.js and similar React application frameworks.
  • Work closely with designers to turn ideas and designs into usable, responsive interfaces rather than simply reproducing static screens.
  • Make accessibility part of the way software is designed and built, not something added at the end.
  • Pay close attention to browser performance, loading behaviour and the experience across different devices and connection speeds.
  • Help shape component architecture and contribute to reusable design systems and shared patterns.
  • Write automated tests at the right level, from component and interaction tests through to browser-based end-to-end testing.
  • Review code, talk through approaches and help less experienced engineers develop their skills.
  • Work alongside other engineers to understand APIs, application behaviour and how the front end fits into the wider platform.
  • Contribute to the front-end engineering community at Code, sharing ideas and helping us improve how we build for the web.
  • Highly competent across core front-end skillsets: HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript (Vanilla) etc. 

You’ll have good experience building production web applications and strong browser fundamentals.

HTML, CSS and JavaScript matter to us. You should understand how browsers work and be able to build interfaces that are responsive, accessible and robust without relying on a framework to solve everything.

You’ll also need solid TypeScript and React experience, with experience working in applications built with React Router, Next.js or similar approaches.

Accessibility should be familiar territory. You should understand semantic HTML, keyboard interaction, focus management and the practical application of WCAG when building interfaces. You should also have experience testing interfaces with screen readers and understand how common interaction patterns are experienced by people using assistive technology.

Performance matters too. You should be able to investigate and improve things such as loading, rendering, JavaScript execution, images and Core Web Vitals.

You’ll need experience with automated testing. The exact tools are less important than knowing what to test and why, but you may have worked with tools such as Vitest, Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress.

Working well with designers is important. That means understanding the intent behind a design, talking through interaction and responsive behaviour, spotting problems and contributing to the solution rather than waiting for every detail to be specified.

Experience with design systems, Storybook, design tokens or shared component libraries is useful, particularly if you’ve helped establish patterns rather than simply consumed them.

As a senior engineer, you’ll also be expected to support others. You don’t need to have formally managed people, but you should be able to review work, share what you know and help other engineers develop.

We don’t expect you to match every technology we use. We’re more interested in strong front-end fundamentals, good engineering judgement and a genuine interest in building accessible, well-crafted web interfaces.

This leader will possess a potent mix of strategic sharpness, creative curiosity, and operational discipline. They will be highly skilled at taking abstract emerging technology trends and framing them into practical, highly structured briefs that solve immediate government communication challenges.

The role demands exceptional interpersonal skills, high EQ, and organizational agility. You will navigate a complex, multi-department government landscape, building trusted relationships with senior civil servants, GCS (Government Communication Service) leads, and diverse internal agency capabilities. title: AI Product Operations Lead
description:
Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal or The Netherlands

About the team

Product Operations sits at the center of how our Product and wider R&D teams work. We help create the systems, practices, and connections that allow teams to focus on solving the right problems and delivering great products.

AI is becoming an increasingly important part of that work. Across R&D, teams are already experimenting with tools like Glean and Claude, building automations, testing agents, and finding new ways to use AI throughout the product development lifecycle.

The opportunity now is to turn that energy into something more systematic.That's where you come in.

About the role

We're looking for an AI Product Operations Lead to build and operate the internal AI Operations capability for R&D.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can take an ambiguous opportunity and turn it into a reliable, adopted solution. You'll help us identify the highest-value problems AI can solve, understand how people work today, design the right solution, build or coordinate its delivery, and then stay accountable for how it performs after launch.

One day, you might be working with a team to understand a frustrating workflow and deciding whether a simple prompt, automation, integration, agent, or internal app is the right answer. The next, you could be improving an existing AI workflow, testing its reliability, helping coordinate access to an enterprise AI tool, or working with IT and InfoSec to make sure a new solution can scale responsibly.

You'll own the connective layer between AI strategy and day-to-day execution across R&D.

This isn't a role for someone who only wants to prototype prompts, manage project plans, or write requirements. We're looking for someone who enjoys combining systems thinking, AI fluency, user discovery, technical execution, and operational ownership—and who wants to see things through.

You'll report to our VP of Product Operations and work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Data Science, IT, InfoSec, and other AI practitioners across Typeform.

What you'll do

  • Build and continuously improve our backlog of AI opportunities across R&D, helping teams identify, prioritize, and sequence the jobs where AI can have the greatest impact.
  • Take ambiguous problems from initial discovery through to delivery: understand the user and workflow, explore options and trade-offs, design the right system, build or coordinate implementation, test, document, launch, measure, and improve.
  • Design simple, AI-native solutions that fit naturally into how people work. You'll know when a prompt is enough—and when the problem calls for a workflow, integration, agent, database, or custom application.
  • Help R&D get more value from enterprise AI tools such as Glean and Claude, partnering with IT and InfoSec on areas including access, configuration, connectors, enablement, and support.
  • Own the lifecycle of the AI systems within your portfolio, including automations, skills, agents, and internal web applications.
  • Establish practical approaches to evaluation, testing, reliability, observability, security, and maintenance—using evidence and feedback to improve systems over time.
  • Partner with teams across R&D to uncover needs, unblock delivery, clarify ownership, and bring the right experts into the work.
  • Help run and evolve our R&D AI governance and enablement practices, giving leaders better visibility into active work, risks, adoption, and outcomes.
  • Participate in Typeform's broader AI governance efforts as an R&D contributor.
  • Work with Finance and other partners to improve visibility into AI tool usage, spend, and value, helping inform investment decisions.
  • Explore and support the development of autonomous agents that can improve how we plan, discover, design, build, evaluate, and manage work across the product development lifecycle.

What you'll bring

  • Strong practical experience applying AI to real-world problems—not just experimenting with models, but building solutions that people actually use.
  • A track record of taking ambiguous problems from discovery through implementation, testing, adoption, and ongoing improvement.
  • Excellent systems thinking. You can understand how people, processes, tools, data flows, integrations, permissions, and technical constraints fit together—and make thoughtful trade-offs between different approaches.
  • Strong user and workflow discovery skills. You know how to get beyond the initial request, understand the real job to be done, and simplify a solution when the original approach is more complex than it needs to be.
  • Hands-on technical fluency and comfort building, modifying, and troubleshooting internal workflows, automations, agents, or applications.
  • Practical experience with modern development practices and tools such as GitHub, repositories and pull requests, basic application hosting, deployment, logging, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Experience managing work independently: prioritizing a backlog, handling dependencies and risks, documenting decisions, and communicating clearly with stakeholders.
  • A strong approach to evaluation and reliability. You think about what "good" looks like, how to test for it, how to collect feedback, and how to improve a system after it goes live.
  • The ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. You're comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions, seeking expert input, and making progress without needing close day-to-day direction.
  • Good judgment around responsible AI, security, access, and governance, and an understanding of when to bring in the right partners.

 

*Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team, empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results.

We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here.

Kenntnisse im Apotheken-, Pharma- oder Gesundheitswesen sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wichtig ist uns vor allem, dass du gerne Probleme löst, strukturiert arbeitest und Freude an der Kommunikation mit Menschen hast. Erfahrung im IT-Support, Service Desk oder technischen Kundensupport ist von Vorteil Gutes technisches Verständnis sowie eine strukturierte und analytische Arbeitsweise Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen sowie im Umgang mit Fehlermeldungen und Logs Hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie eine klare, freundliche und verbindliche Kommunikation Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Kenntnisse im IT-Service-Management, zum Beispiel nach ITIL v4, sind wünschenswert Grundkenntnisse in Webanwendungen, APIs und JSON sind von Vorteil Kenntnisse im Apotheken-, Pharma- oder Gesundheitswesen sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung Uns ist wichtiger, wie du an Probleme herangehst, wie du kommunizierst und ob du Lust hast, dich in unsere Produkte und Technologien einzuarbeiten, als dass du bereits jedes Kästchen erfüllst. Auch der sinnvolle Einsatz von KI im Arbeitsalltag wird bei uns ausdrücklich gefördert und ist bereits Teil unserer Arbeitsweise. Dabei arbeiten wir an der Schnittstelle zwischen moderner Softwareentwicklung, Telematikinfrastruktur und neuen digitalen Versorgungskonzepten. Wir arbeiten hybrid und haben ein modernes Büro in Berlin-Mitte, das wir als Ort für Zusammenarbeit, Austausch und gemeinsame Teamtage nutzen. Klingt nach etwas, das zu dir passen könnte? Dann melde dich bei uns. Ob mit Lebenslauf oder einfach ein paar Sätzen darüber, wer du bist, was du bisher gemacht hast und warum dich die Rolle interessiert – wir möchten vor allem dich kennenlernen. description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. The role: We are looking for a Head of Data Science to build Paddle's data science capability from the ground up. Our Merchant of Record model gives us a data position no PSP or billing provider has: subscription and pricing context alongside granular payment-outcome data, across thousands of software businesses. This role exists to turn that into economic value by putting machine learning and agentic systems into production. The mandate is deliberately narrow and deliberately ambitious: data science at Paddle owns automated decisioning inside the product — traditional machine learning and agentic systems alike — not decision-support analytics. We have a long list of candidate opportunities than we can fund, spanning payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance. We have a working hypothesis about which of these pays back first, and we'll share it — but part of the job in your first quarter is to pressure-test it, size the alternatives yourself, and tell us where to start. This is a founding role, and for the first few quarters it is a building role more than a managing one. You'll be the only person in the function: doing the analysis, engineering the features, training and evaluating the models or agents, taking the first system live with our engineering teams — and then operating it, answerable for its uptime, its drift and its numbers. Once the first use cases are proving out, you'll hire and lead a hub-and-spoke team of data scientists and machine learning engineers embedded across our highest-value business areas. You'll report into the VP of Data and work in close partnership with Product, Payments, Engineering, Risk and Finance. What you'll do: Prioritise which opportunities have the biggest impact.. Build a value-based use-case backlog across payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance; size the leading candidates properly; and make the call on sequencing with the relevant Product, Risk, RevOps and Finance stakeholders. This gets refreshed quarterly. Personally deliver the first system end to end: the analysis and back-test, the features, the model, policy or agent, the deployment, and the shadow and A/B tests that prove it works. Not a spec handed to someone else to build. Operate what you deploy. Own monitoring, retraining, drift response, incident handling and rollback for live decisioning, alongside the engineering teams whose services call it — and set the expectation that the function runs its systems rather than shipping them. Work across both traditional ML and agentic systems, and be honest about which a problem actually needs: a propensity or uplift model, a policy of rules, or an agent with tools, evals against golden answer sets and trace-level observability. Several of our strongest candidate use cases point each way. Build and lead the team — hire senior data scientists embedded in value areas and machine learning engineers in the hub, and set the professional standards, shared methods and reusable components the function runs on. Establish the production stack alongside Data Platform and Engineering: reproducible training data, code and artefacts; a model registry; inference services with real latency, availability and rollback requirements; historically accurate features where decisions need backdated reconstruction; eval harnesses and trace observability for agentic workflows; and monitoring for data quality, drift, model performance and economic outcomes. Start ad hoc where that's sufficient and platformise once the first use cases have shown what's actually needed. Own value capture end to end. Shadow-test and A/B test every deployment against the incumbent strategy, translate metric movement into a financial number on a methodology co-signed by Finance, and publish a quarterly report on realised value. Set the governance model for automated decisioning — proportionate risk assessment, clear ownership, latency and availability requirements, human escalation and rollback — working with Legal, Privacy, Compliance and Risk on GDPR, EU AI Act and payments obligations, and producing the evidence early enough to shape the design. Define the boundaries and the working relationship with Product Science, Analytics Engineering, Data Platform and AI Enablement, so accountability for decision support versus automated decisioning stays unambiguous. Deliver cross-functionally: embed in delivery groups with product owners, domain experts and platform engineers rather than handing models over the wall. We'd love to hear from you if you: Experienced leading data science or ML teams that own systems in production, with deployments that moved a commercial metric and kept running afterwards. Proofs of concept and dashboards are not what we're hiring for. Hands-on now, not formerly. Your first quarters are spent writing SQL and Python, engineering features, evaluating models and agents, and doing the work that gets a system live — not reviewing someone else's. Experienced across both traditional ML and agentic systems, and clear about how they differ in practice: propensity and uplift models, feature pipelines and drift on one side; tool and context design, prompt and retrieval iteration, evals against golden answer sets and trace observability on the other. Practised at running live systems rather than just launching them — monitoring, retraining, incident response, rollback, and the on-call reality of a decision the business depends on. Pragmatic about method: happy to argue for rules or heuristics where they capture most of the value, and to reserve models and agents for where they genuinely earn their keep. Comfortable with an undefined starting point. There's a long list of candidate use cases and a strong internal hypothesis, but no fixed roadmap — you'll be expected to form your own view, back it with numbers, and defend it to an executive audience. Strong on measurement — experimentation, uplift modelling, back-testing — and willing to hold your own work to a financial number that Finance will scrutinise. Fluent in the engineering side of production ML and agents (training pipelines, model registries, inference services, feature stores, drift detection, trace observability) and able to hold your own with senior engineers on latency, availability, observability and rollback. Able to hire, level and develop senior data scientists and ML engineers, and to set standards for a function that doesn't exist yet. Credible with executives and commercial stakeholders: you can take a use case from business problem to value estimate to prioritisation decision, and say no to low-value work. Experienced in payments, fintech, subscriptions, high-volume commercial operations or another regulated transactional domain — enough to get to a credible value estimate in a new area quickly. Comfortable treating regulated ML as a design constraint rather than paperwork — model risk assessment, DPIAs, auditability, traceability of model and policy versions to production decision logic.   • Personally deliver the first system end to end: the analysis and back-test, the features, the model, policy or agent, the deployment, and the shadow and A/B tests that prove it works. Not a spec handed to someone else to build.

  • Work across both traditional ML and agentic systems, and be honest about which a problem actually needs: a propensity or uplift model, a policy of rules, or an agent with tools, evals against golden answer sets and trace-level observability.   • Build and lead the team — hire senior data scientists embedded in value areas and machine learning engineers in the hub, and set the professional standards, shared methods and reusable components the function runs on.

  • Establish the production stack alongside Data Platform and Engineering: reproducible training data, code and artefacts; a model registry; inference services with real latency, availability and rollback requirements; historically accurate features where decisions need backdated reconstruction; eval harnesses and trace observability for agentic workflows; and monitoring for data quality, drift, model performance and economic outcomes.   • Own value capture end to end. Shadow-test and A/B test every deployment against the incumbent strategy, translate metric movement into a financial number on a methodology co-signed by Finance, and publish a quarterly report on realised value.

  • Set the governance model for automated decisioning — proportionate risk assessment, clear ownership, latency and availability requirements, human escalation and rollback — working with Legal, Privacy, Compliance and Risk on GDPR, EU AI Act and payments obligations, and producing the evidence early enough to shape the design.

  • Define the boundaries and the working relationship with Product Science, Analytics Engineering, Data Platform and AI Enablement, so accountability for decision support versus automated decisioning stays unambiguous.

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Platform team in an internal-facing role focused on delivery excellence. You'll be the connective tissue across product teams — enabling fast, informed decision-making, keeping engineering delivery on track day-to-day, making sure our platform holds up to country-specific regulatory requirements as we scale globally and defining requirements for the platform back office.

Alongside the day-to-day delivery work, you'll run a set of platform-wide programs: centralizing consent management and interfacing with the GTM team. This role is less about owning a single customer-facing roadmap and more about being the operational and program backbone that keeps cross-functional delivery moving smoothly and compliantly.

What You'll Do

Delivery & Coordination

  • Liaise with Group Product Managers (GPMs) — Act as a key point of coordination across product fault lines, surfacing decisions that need to be made and driving them to quick, well-informed resolution.

  • Lead daily ceremonies — Run stand-ups and other recurring delivery ceremonies with engineering, keeping teams aligned on priorities, blockers, and progress.

  • Troubleshoot with engineering — Partner directly with engineering leads to unblock delivery issues in real time, digging into technical details as needed.

  • Lead triage for cross-cutting bugs and defects — Own the process for identifying, prioritizing, and assigning ownership of issues that span multiple product areas or teams, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Drive process improvement — Identify recurring delivery bottlenecks or compliance gaps and put in place scalable processes to prevent them.

Platform Delivery (Program)

  • Country-specific requirements — Own the platform-wide program ensuring the platform meets country-specific regulatory and functional requirements (e.g., GDPR and other regional regulations) consistently as we scale globally.

  • Centralize consent management — Lead the program to consolidate consent management (data processing, marketing, cookie consent, etc.) into a single, consistent framework across the platform, replacing fragmented per-product implementations.

  • Build the platform back office for technical support.

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of product management experience, including experience in platform or delivery-focused roles.

  • Proven ability to work across multiple teams and stakeholders to drive decisions quickly, especially in ambiguous or contested situations.

  • Strong operational rigor — comfortable running ceremonies, triage processes, and cross-team workflows, alongside running longer-running platform programs and owning a live product.

  • Experience working closely with engineering on troubleshooting and delivery issues; technical fluency is important.

  • Experience owning a partner-facing or multi-market product, with sensitivity to regional variation across a large footprint (70 countries, in this case).

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders (including GPMs) without direct authority.

  • A bias toward action and strong prioritization instincts in a fast-moving, cross-cutting role.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a platform or infrastructure product role at a multi-market or global company.

  • Background working with legal/compliance teams on regulatory rollouts, especially consent management programs.

  • Experience setting up or scaling incident management, bug triage, or internal support tooling.

  • Experience with franchise, partner, or multi-tenant portal products specifically.

Why You Should Join

Most internal-facing delivery roles are pure coordination — you keep other people's things moving and own nothing yourself. This one comes with real roadmap and experience decisions for making a platform product portfolio truly global. Sitting across all the GPMs gives you genuine organizational leverage and visibility into the whole product landscape, which builds the kind of cross-functional credibility that prepares you for future leadership roles. You'll also get to build things properly rather than patch them: centralized consent management is greenfield, replacing fragmented per-product implementations that most people inherit and spend years apologizing for.

At Berlitz, connecting people across languages and cultures is at the heart of what we do. Our global workplace reflects the diverse world we serve, bringing together different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We create an inclusive environment where everyone has an equal opportunity to belong, contribute and grow.

Ready to shape what’s next? Join us and help build the future with us.

We're the agentic operating system for the enterprise. We enable business teams to build, scale, and manage the most capable AI employees on the market.

We raised $3M from YC and angels like Aravind (CEO Perplexity) and Rahul Vohra (Superhuman). We have thousands of agents running at 2,000+ person scale-ups and Fortune 500 companies. We have PMF and are doubling revenue every month. We have far more demand than we can handle.

About the role
I'm Sacha, Chief of Staff at Dataleap. I own our existing customers, and I need someone alongside me to make our current accounts win with Dataleap.

This isn't a sales role. Your job is to make the customers we already have wildly successful, to walk into their organizations, find the people who want to build agents, and help them actually do it. You'll run adoption on the ground: sit with teams, understand their work, build agents alongside them, unblock them, and turn curious users into daily believers. When a customer succeeds, it's because you made it happen.

We're building out our German office, and this is the moment to get in. You'll work directly with me and our team on the ground. As we scale, this role has a real path to grow into a full-time role in the Growth team at Dataleap, more ownership, bigger accounts, deeper work. This is your chance to show what you've got, and I'll make sure it's the fastest growth of your career.

What you'll own

  • Customer adoption. Drive real usage inside our existing accounts. Find the champions, enable them, and help them pay it forward across their org.

  • Building agents alongside customers. Sit with their teams, understand the messy details of their work, and build agents in Dataleap that solve real problems. You prove the value by shipping it.

  • Being the trusted partner. Become the person our customers love to have in the room, the one who gets their world, makes them better, and makes them feel taken care of.

  • Training and enablement. Run workshops, hackathons, and hands-on sessions that turn non-technical teams into confident agent builders.

Who you are

  • Hungry and proactive. You don't wait to be told. You see what needs doing and you're already on it.

  • Great with people. You're warm, confident, and easy to trust. You can walk into a room of people you've never met and have them rooting for you by the end.

How we work
This is your life's work right now, and mine too. We operate like athletes: we take care of ourselves and our bodies, and we work hard and win. High standards, high output, no excuses, and we enjoy the ride together.

  • Not for someone who needs rigid structure or waits to be told what to do.

  • Direct work with me and exposure to our network at YC, Founders Inc, and CDTM.

  • A real path to full-time: grow into a full-time role in the Growth team at Dataleap as we scale.

raw.company_name: Lovebetter Gesellschaft für männliche Sexualität mbH
raw.title: Growth Intelligence & AI Analyst
raw.description:
Warum gibt es diese Rolle - und warum jetzt?

Lovebetter wächst in eine neue Phase. Wir haben starke Inhalte, eine klare Mission, Gavin als Gesicht der Marke und eine gewachsene Marketingdatenbank, deren Potenzial wir künftig deutlich systematischer nutzen wollen. Gleichzeitig wollen wir Marketing nicht länger nach Bauchgefühl steuern, sondern klar verstehen, welche Themen, Kanäle, Funnels und Kontaktpunkte wirklich Wachstum erzeugen.

Dafür suchen wir dich.

Als Growth Intelligence & AI Analyst bist du die Person, die aus Daten, KI, CRM, Content-Performance und Marketinglogik ein klares Steuerungssystem baut. Du erkennst Muster, entwickelst Hypothesen, prüfst Tests und hilfst uns, schneller bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Diese Rolle ist bewusst breiter als ein klassischer Analystenjob. Du sollst nicht nur Dashboards bauen, sondern aktiv mitdenken, wie Lovebetter mehr qualifizierte Leads, bessere Funnel, stärkere Lifecycle-Kommunikation und planbareren Umsatz aufbaut.

Wofür Lovebetter steht 

Wir lösen sexuelle Probleme wie vorzeitigen Samenerguss oder Erektionsprobleme mit Männern und befähigen sie, ihre innere Stärke, sexuelle Zufriedenheit und Lebensqualität von innen heraus zu transformieren.
Unsere Arbeit wirkt weit über den Einzelnen hinaus: auf Partnerschaften, Familien und kommende Generationen.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt, Wirkung messbar macht und weiß, dass echter Impact aus Exzellenz, Struktur und Umsetzungskraft entsteht.

Deine Mission als Growth Intelligence & AI Analyst

Du machst Lovebetter messbarer, lernfähiger und wachstumsstärker. Du verbindest Business Intelligence, CRM, KI, Content-Performance und operative Growth-Tests. Du analysierst, welche Themen Männer wirklich bewegen, welche Inhalte Vertrauen aufbauen, welche Funnels funktionieren und welche Kontaktsegmente aktiviert werden können.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem CMO, Content Production, Chatter, Agenturen und später CRM-/Lifecycle-Strukturen zusammen. Gerade am Anfang wirst du auch Themen mit abdecken, die noch nicht sauber verteilt sind: CRM-Analyse, Reaktivierungslogik, kleine Website- oder Landingpage-Tests und operative Growth-Experimente.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Reporting & Business Intelligence aufbauen: Du entwickelst ein schlankes KPI- und Reporting-System für Content, Funnel, CRM, Paid, SEO, Chatter und Sales-Schnittstellen. Ziel ist, jede Woche klar zu sehen, was funktioniert, was nicht funktioniert und wo Wachstum entsteht

  • Hypothesen entwickeln und testen: Du formulierst klare Growth-Hypothesen, zum Beispiel zu Hooks, Zielgruppen, Freebies, Landingpages, CRM-Segmenten oder Funnel-Schritten, und prüfst diese anhand von Daten

  • CRM-Potenziale sichtbar machen: Du analysierst bestehende Marketingkontakte, entwickelst Segmentierungslogiken, identifizierst Reaktivierungshebel und misst, welche Lifecycle- oder Upsell-Impulse funktionieren

  • AI für Analyse, Research und Marketingsteuerung nutzen: Du setzt KI ein, um schneller Muster zu erkennen, Content- und Funnel-Daten auszuwerten, Zielgruppenfragen zu clustern, Tests vorzubereiten und Entscheidungsgrundlagen zu schaffen

  • Operative Growth-Tests mitdenken und umsetzen: Du bleibst nicht nur im Analysemodus. Du denkst kleinere Tests auf Landingpages, Website, Formularen, E-Mail-Strecken oder Funnel-Schritten mit und kannst einfache Anpassungen operativ begleiten

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Direkter Wachstumshebel: Deine Analysen beeinflussen, welche Themen, Kanäle, Funnels und CRM-Strecken wir priorisieren

  • Daten statt Bauchgefühl: Du baust die Grundlage dafür, dass Marketingentscheidungen messbar, vergleichbar und lernfähig werden

  • KI als echter Produktivitätshebel: Du nutzt AI nicht als Spielerei, sondern für Research, Mustererkennung, Hypothesen, Reporting und bessere Entscheidungen

  • Breite Verantwortung: Du arbeitest nicht nur im Dashboard, sondern denkst CRM, Content, Funnel, Website-Tests und operative Growth-Experimente mit

  • Gestaltungsraum: Du hilfst dabei, Lovebetter von einem content-getriebenen Marketing-Team zu einem klaren Revenue-Marketing-System weiterzuentwickeln

Dein Impact

Wenn du deinen Job exzellent machst, entsteht:

  • ein Marketing-System, das klar erkennt, welche Maßnahmen wirklich Wachstum erzeugen

  • bessere Entscheidungen bei Content, CRM, Paid, SEO, Chatter und Funnel

  • aktivierte Bestandskontakte statt ungenutzter Datenbank

  • mehr qualifizierte Leads durch saubere Hypothesen und Tests

  • ein Weekly Growth Reporting, das dem Team Orientierung und Priorität gibt

  • ein skalierbares Zusammenspiel aus KI, Daten, CRM und Customer Journey

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns, dich kennenzulernen.

Schick uns keine Standardbewerbung.
Erzähl uns lieber:

  • welche Marketing-, BI- oder Growth-Systeme du bereits aufgebaut oder verbessert hast

  • wie du KI heute konkret in deiner Arbeit nutzt

  • welche Hypothesen oder Tests du schon entwickelt und ausgewertet hast

  • wo du schon Verantwortung für Reporting, CRM, Funnel oder Performance getragen hast

  • und warum du glaubst, dass genau du Lovebetter datenbasiert und wachstumsseitig auf das nächste Level bringst


Wen wir suchen (und wen nicht)

Diese Rolle passt zu dir, wenn …

  • du mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in Marketing Analytics, BI, Growth, Performance Marketing oder Revenue Operations hast

  • du exzellent mit Zahlen, Daten und Zusammenhängen arbeitest und daraus klare Wachstumshebel ableitest

  • du KI täglich nutzt, um Analysen, Research, Hypothesen, Segmentierungen oder Prozesse schneller und besser zu machen

  • du CRM, Funnel und Lifecycle-Marketing verstehst und erkennst, wie aus Kontakten qualifizierte Leads und Umsatz entstehen

  • du Hypothesen klar formulieren, testen und auswerten kannst

  • du strukturiert, eigenständig und lösungsorientiert arbeitest und dem CMO klar sagen kannst: „Das ist der Hebel. Das sollten wir testen. Das sollten wir stoppen.“

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn …

  • du Zahlen nur „berichtest“, aber daraus keine klaren Entscheidungen ableitest

  • du KI spannend findest, sie aber nicht aktiv in deinen Arbeitsalltag integrierst

  • du dich ausschließlich als Dashboard- oder Reporting-Person verstehst

  • du kein Interesse daran hast, CRM, Content, Paid, Website und Funnel zusammenzudenken

  • du dich in Analysen verlierst, ohne ins Handeln zu kommen
